free_tier.stated: no free tier; VPS 2000 G12.5 is EUR 26.92 a month on a 12-month term including 19 per cent VAT, for 8 vCore, 16 GB of RAM and 256 GB of SSD

retention.stated: the disk persists while the plan is paid; the page states no deletion clock

egress.terms: traffic flat rate with no byte quota printed on the plan card
egress.free_allowance: unlimited under the traffic flat rate

interface_detail: remote console and DVD drive in the SCP; Windows is installed by the buyer, so the admin path is the console until RDP answers
tooling: SCP console and virtual DVD; any RDP client after install
chaining: the cheapest 16 GB machine from a long-established German host, and the only row where the buyer installs Windows from their own media. The 180-day test licence is the catch.

limits.value: traffic flat rate with no printed rate

limits_note: netcup does not sell a Windows licence. The FAQ states that the self-install image carries a 180-day test licence and that no licence can be bought from netcup.
binding_note: the 180-day test licence is the clock. After it, the buyer must license the image or rebuild.

identity_cost.detail: an account and a payment method at order; the checkout was not read

reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the price includes German VAT and drops for a non-EU billing address.
confidence_note: the shape and the four term prices are printed on the page. The VAT-free figure is arithmetic at 19 per cent and the Windows licence sentence is the vendor FAQ.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'VPS 2000 G12.5 ... 8 vCore (x86) ... 16 GB RAM ... 256 GB SSD ... 12 months contract period, from monthly EUR 26.92 EUR 30.96 (incl. 19% VAT)'

quoted: 'netcup does not offer any ready-made Windows servers. However, you have the option of installing Windows on your server yourself via the SCP. Please note that this is a 180-day test license. Beyond that, you cannot purchase Windows software licenses via netcup.'

notes: The EUR 26.92 figure includes 19 per cent VAT. A buyer outside the EU pays about EUR 22.62, which is USD 25.32 at the 2026-10-23 ECB rate. The 24-month term is 26 per cent below the monthly term, but the first payment is the whole term.

extras.windows_licence: none sold; 180-day test licence on self-install
